name: 2027 STFM Annual Spring Conference
organizer: Society of Teachers of Family Medicine
description: The 2027 STFM Annual Spring Conference is the yearly meeting of the Society of Teachers of Family Medicine, held at the Sheraton Grand Chicago Riverwalk in Chicago, Illinois. The conference brings together family medicine educators for presentations on teaching, research, and clinical practice.
